findings.title: Async deletion in forEach is never awaited
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {... await getCalendar ...}) launches an async callback whose returned promise is discarded by forEach. The function then sends the reschedule email and returns true without waiting for calendar.deleteEvent / deleteMeeting to finish, and the surrounding try/catch cannot catch rejections from the async callback. Consequence: calendar/video events may never be deleted or failures are silently lost as unhandled rejections while the booking is already marked rescheduled.

findings.title: Async deletion in forEach is never awaited
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {... await getCalendar ...}) discards the promise returned by each async iteration. The code proceeds to send email and return without awaiting deletions, and errors inside the callback bypass the enclosing try/catch. Consequence: old calendar/video events can be orphaned and deletion errors become unhandled rejections.

findings.title: Async calendar/video cancellation in forEach is fire-and-forget
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {... await getCalendar ... calendar?.deleteEvent ...}) does not await the per-booking deletions. The mutation continues to send the reschedule email and webhooks immediately. Consequence: the previous slot may not be freed before the user reschedules, failures are unobserved, and rejections escape error handling.

findings.title: Recurring-cancel apiDeletes populated from unawaited forEach
findings.body: For recurring cancellation the code does bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(...); ... apiDeletes.push(await calendar?.deleteEvent(...)); }). Because forEach does not await the async callbacks, the later await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes)) can run while apiDeletes is still empty. Adding await getCalendar moves the push even later, worsening the race. Consequence: recurring bookings are marked CANCELLED in the DB while external calendar events are never deleted.
